en_title: 'To Be Able to Identify the Mechanism Does Not Invalidate the Mechanism' — Christopher Nolan Lays Out a 'Fundamental Flaw' With Amateur Film Criticism
cn_title: 克里斯托弗·诺兰：看懂机制不代表电影失效
subtitle: 别把套路当缺陷
opus_summary: 克里斯托弗·诺兰认为，业余影评常把看懂电影叙事机制误认为作品失效，并称这是批评中的根本缺陷。他解释说，电影语言有规则也能被打破，但创作者和观众始终在共同塑造作品意义。

paragraphs.en: Christopher Nolan has laid out what he believes to be a "fundamental flaw" with amateur film criticism.
paragraphs.cn: 克里斯托弗·诺兰阐述了他认为业余电影批评存在的一个「根本缺陷」。

paragraphs.en: The director in charge of July box office hit The Odyssey examined how audiences pick apart movies during an interview with podcast host Zhong Shu . He took aim at those who recognize the inner workings of how a movie chooses to tell its story and then spin that as if it's a negative.
paragraphs.cn: 这位执导7月票房热门电影《奥德赛》的导演，在接受播客主持人Zhong Shu采访时分析了观众如何拆解电影。他批评那些看出电影选择如何讲故事的内在机制，却把这件事说成负面因素的人。

paragraphs.en: He explained, "To identify the mechanism does not invalidate the mechanism."
paragraphs.cn: 他解释道：「看出机制，并不会让机制失效。」

paragraphs.en: "I think that, when you're talking about storytelling, you're always in conversation with the expectations of the audience," Nolan said. "So it really is an energy that's brought from the audience, as well as an energy that's put forward from the story itself.
paragraphs.cn: 诺兰说：「我认为，当你谈论叙事时，你始终在与观众的期待对话。所以，这确实既有观众带来的能量，也有故事本身释放出的能量。」

paragraphs.en: "The trite version of this, or the criticism often leveled at movies in general, is, 'Oh, the character has to be made sympathetic, so the character is manipulated in different ways and changed in different ways.' That's a fundamental flaw of film criticism in a way, or storytelling criticism, because to be able to identify the mechanism does not invalidate the mechanism.
paragraphs.cn: 「一种陈腐的说法，或者说电影经常遭遇的批评是：『哦，角色必须变得讨人喜欢，所以角色被用不同方式操纵，也被用不同方式改变。』这在某种程度上是电影批评或叙事批评的根本缺陷，因为看出机制并不会让机制失效。

paragraphs.en: "That's a real problem with criticism today because people have this idea that, 'Because I can understand why the story affects me the way it is, therefore, it didn't work.' That's not how storytelling works."
paragraphs.cn: 「这是如今批评中的一个真实问题，因为人们有这样的想法：『既然我能理解故事为何会这样影响我，那它肯定就没起作用。』叙事并不是这样运作的。」

paragraphs.en: He continued, saying that, when storytellers create their heroic figures, they must be "mindful of the energy that the audience brings to that story and the interaction between our intention and the way the audience receives that."
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说，叙事创作者塑造英雄人物时，必须「留意观众为故事带来的能量，以及我们的意图与观众接受方式之间的互动」。

paragraphs.en: Nolan opened the door for critics to pick apart his latest project when The Odyssey set sail in theaters, including Imax , last month. Although the negative noise surrounding it actually quietened down a bit upon its release, there are those who have been quite vocal when it comes to their problems with the film.
paragraphs.cn: 上月《奥德赛》在包括Imax在内的影院上映时，诺兰也让影评人有机会拆解自己的最新作品。虽然围绕电影的负面声音在上映后其实稍微平息了一些，但仍有人直言不讳地谈论自己对这部电影的不满。

paragraphs.en: One notable individual to have spoken up included Greek translator Emily Wilson, who Nolan had previously cited during the lead-up to The Odyssey's premiere. She published a harsh (and lengthy) review of the movie last week, saying she would have been "ashamed to have written any part of this script."
paragraphs.cn: 发声者中有一位值得注意的人物是希腊语译者Emily Wilson，诺兰此前曾在《奥德赛》首映前的宣传过程中提到过她。她上周发表了一篇尖锐而且篇幅很长的影评，称自己「会为参与编写这份剧本的任何部分感到羞耻」。

paragraphs.en: As Nolan elaborated on his thoughts, he made it clear that his complaint with how some approach film criticism is not directed at professional critics, but amateur ones.
paragraphs.cn: 诺兰进一步阐述观点时明确表示，他对部分人进行电影批评方式的不满，针对的不是专业影评人，而是业余影评人。

paragraphs.en: "When I was talking about film criticism, I was talking more about amateur film criticism than professional film criticism because professional film criticism tends to understand the necessity for the mechanisms. So, you're looking at a lingua franca of storytelling created by Hollywood for the last hundred years that is very, effectively universal.
paragraphs.cn: 「我谈论电影批评时，更多指的是业余电影批评，而非专业电影批评，因为专业影评往往理解这些机制的必要性。你们看到的是好莱坞在过去100年创造的一种叙事通用语言，它实际上具有普遍性。

paragraphs.en: "So, it is its own language, and that language is understood by people all over the world, which is what's incredible about it. It is a very accessible, modern language of storytelling, and it has certain rules. It has conventions. You can break those conventions. You can bend them. You can move them, but you have to be aware of them the whole time.
paragraphs.cn: 「所以，它本身就是一种语言，而且全世界的人都能理解这种语言，这正是它不可思议的地方。这是一种非常易于理解的现代叙事语言，也有自己的规则和惯例。你可以打破、弯曲或移动这些惯例，但始终都必须意识到它们的存在。

paragraphs.en: Here is my interview with Christopher Nolan: are you a bard for a civilization at dusk? pic.twitter.com/dQION5v6bl
paragraphs.cn: 这是我对克里斯托弗·诺兰的采访：你是暮色文明的吟游诗人吗？pic.twitter.com/dQION5v6bl

paragraphs.en: "As I say, I'm thinking more of amateur criticism when I say that people who, because they feel they've identified the mechanism, they feel that it invalidates it, that can be true of certain elements, and film grammar – film language – evolves with that. So, when a trope becomes too familiar to an audience, then it has to be changed, but we do, as filmmakers, avail ourselves of that common language. We build on that understanding. Our audience has seen many films, and they understand that language, and so you're playing with that language."
paragraphs.cn: 「正如我所说，当我说那些因为觉得自己看出了机制，就认为机制失效的人时，我更多是在考虑业余批评。这对某些元素来说可能确实如此，电影语法——电影语言——也会随之演变。当某种套路对观众来说过于熟悉时，就必须改变它；但作为电影人，我们确实会利用这种共通语言。我们建立在这种理解之上。观众看过很多电影，也理解那种语言，所以你其实是在与这种语言博弈。」

paragraphs.en: Nolan is no stranger to criticism online. Conversations about The Odyssey have been polluted by complaints regarding a lack of " " and its casting choices . The director has said he wasn't too bothered by it , though, especially when it came to the backlash that arrived before the film even premiered.
paragraphs.cn: 诺兰并不陌生于网上的批评。围绕《奥德赛》的讨论被「缺少某种内容」以及选角选择等抱怨污染了。不过导演表示自己并没有太在意，尤其是电影甚至尚未首映前就出现的反弹。

paragraphs.en: He told The Telegraph that the conversations that happen before a film's arrival are "always irrelevant." He also added that his 10 years of work with Batman helped him prepare for some of the more vocal moviegoers.
paragraphs.cn: 他告诉The Telegraph，电影上映前发生的讨论「始终无关紧要」。他还说，自己与Batman合作的10年经历，帮助他为那些声音更大的观众做好了准备。

paragraphs.en: When it comes to The Odyssey's journey post-release, however, it seems the cast and crew backing the film have little to worry about. As relayed by review aggregator Rotten Tomatoes, critics and audiences have largely fallen in love with the film. We here at IGN gave it an 8/10 review .
paragraphs.cn: 不过，说到《奥德赛》上映后的旅程，支持这部电影的演员和工作人员似乎没什么可担心的。正如影评汇总网站Rotten Tomatoes所传达的那样，影评人和观众总体上都爱上了这部电影。IGN为其打出了8/10分。

paragraphs.en: The movie recently had its 70mm Imax release extended by one month after it exceeded expectations at the box office during its July 17 opening weekend . Following weekends have been similarly successful, as its second dropped just 19% , while its third saw it cross $900 million globally as it continues the trek to $1 billion.
paragraphs.cn: 这部电影在7月17日上映的首个周末票房超出预期后，最近将70mm Imax版本的上映期延长了一个月。之后的周末同样成功，第二个周末票房仅下降19%，第三个周末全球票房突破9亿美元(约合人民币61亿元)，并继续向10亿美元(约合人民币68亿元)迈进。
